rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a static image, but includes speculative features like early hatching/central ICM location and some equivocation between stage 3 and 4.

Integrates age, prior live birth, ovarian reserve, BMI, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and endometriosis well, though some interactions (e.g., fresh vs frozen context, severity of endometriosis) remain somewhat generic.
Overall logic is sound, but the response contains internal inconsistency in probability estimates (45-60%, 50-65%, 55-70%) and some speculative discussion not tightly tied to the provided case.

Mostly evidence-based on SET, luteal support, and avoiding add-ons, but includes questionable or nonstandard suggestions such as D&E/Gestrinone for adenomyosis and some unnecessary investigations without indication.

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and contingency planning after failure, though future-cycle advice is partly generic and occasionally overreaches.
